title: Lazy Sunday Meat Tagine
description: A hearty, comforting dish perfect for a relaxing Sunday meal. This keto meat tagine is a flavorful and nutritious option for a low-carb diet.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the ground meat and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, and chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
